environment: ### Org-wide

**Organizations**: the GitHub owners listed in the private file ~/.claude/orgs.json, which is not shown here. Repos under a listed owner are internal. A git pre-push hook (core.hooksPath=~/.claude/git-hooks, set only for the agent's commands) refuses any push whose owner is not listed, and every push when the file is missing or malformed. Skipping or redirecting git hooks (--no-verify, core.hooksPath, GIT_CONFIG_*) is denied
**Cloud provider(s)**: None configured
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: None configured
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None configured
**Network posture**: None configured
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Repository visibility**: private for every repo under the Organizations above unless gh shows otherwise; check before pushing confidential material to one not yet confirmed
**Default / protected branches**: `main` is the default everywhere; no classic protection rules listed and rulesets not queryable — treat `main` as protected by convention
**Source control**: repos under the Organizations above and their origin remotes only; no other GitHub orgs or remotes are trusted

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: ~/.delphi/ (private personal corpus, never committed to any repo); any .env file, credentials/, credentials.py; any file or store holding personal data, confidential business data, credentials, or regulated data. Preserve exact handles when known and share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar

**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment (hyphen/underscore/dot-delimited — e.g. matches `prod-db`, not `producer`)
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development

**Trusted repos**: every checkout whose origin remote is under one of the Organizations above. Private, so confidential (non-secret) material is OK to commit/push; secrets and sensitive personal or entrusted data are never cleared by visibility alone
**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured

**Permission policy**: a MUTATING action asks; an IRREVERSIBLE action is blocked. Irreversibility is judged by AUDIENCE, not by the verb: an action that stays inside the Organizations above and can be deleted or reverted there (pushing a feature branch, opening a PR on a private org repo) is mutating and asks. An action that leaves that boundary (a public repo, a gist, email, any external service), rewrites or deletes shared history (force-push, deleting a remote branch, pushing to main or master), or destroys data with no copy (flushing a database) is irreversible and blocked. Apply this to any command no rule matches. The user approves every commit and push; the agent emits the runbook and states the one line to run.
